title: ValueError: No scheme supplied in webhook notification target URL
description: Third-party merchant webhooks fail to dispatch when registered without an explicit protocol prefix (e.g. 'hooks.slack.com/...'). The system throws a ValueError instead of prepending https://.
error_log:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File 'app/services/webhook_service.py', line 12, in prepare_webhook_target
    raise ValueError(f"Invalid URL '{target_url}': No scheme supplied. Perhaps you meant https://{target_url}?")
ValueError: Invalid URL 'api.partner.com/events': No scheme supplied.
recent_changes: Commit d820aa: Strict URL parsing validation on partner webhooks
expected_behavior: Should automatically default to https:// if no scheme is provided
actual_behavior: Throws unhandled ValueError on schemeless target URLs
